cause_quote: The commit added `const bypassAllowlist = readBundledDiscoveryModeMemoized(params.env) === "compat";` to the policy used by installed-plugin activation, so the existing CLI lookups that omitted the environment used the process state root.
user_saw: An available bundled CLI backend could be missing when the requested state directory used compatibility mode and the process state directory enforced the allowlist.
summary: The fix passes the caller’s environment to installed-plugin activation in both CLI backend lookups and routes the remaining worker-backed tests through the forked database-worker project.
reasoning: The blamed refactor preserved an existing three-argument activation call in both lookup paths. I checked the parent and diff of #123416 and found that it introduced state-root-aware compatibility into the activation predicate while leaving those callers without the new environment argument, so CLI activation used the wrong root from the first version of that policy.
